texts.value: Required for ribosomal protein bS1 (rpsA) to bind to the 30S subunit

Part of the 30S ribosomal subunit, contacts bS1 (PubMed:12068815). Some nascent polypeptide chains are able to cross-link to this protein in situ (PubMed:9716382). In collided ribosomes contacts ribosome rescue factor SmrB (PubMed:35264790)
Belongs to the universal ribosomal protein uS2 family
